checklist_item: NOTICE 1 explained as filing lag, not lapse
claim_as_stated: That is almost certainly filing lag, not lapse [I].
exact_values_found: All 14 have FY2024 RENEWAL filings on file. Payment for 13 of the 14 was processed 2 to 94 days after 2025-11-15 (approval 2 to 122 days after). The remaining sponsor paid 1 day before that date. CO SOS calls these expiration notices; for campaign reports it uses delinquent notice.
discrepancies: A Monday notice 1 after a Sunday due date is the published schedule, not an anomaly; the Sunday does not explain it.
contradictory_evidence: Under CO rules a registration is valid until the report due date, so the registrations are technically expired until the report is filed; not lapse is too strong.
interpretation_challenge: Likely transient, but the lag sits with the sponsors (recurring late filing within the extension cycle), not with SOS processing. NOTICE 1 within 30 days should be reported as expiration notice (recent), not delinquent. Correction proposed.
